items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to the crime of criminal trespass

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to the crime of lewd criminal trespass

B.actClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to public lewdness

summary: Expands the class B misdemeanor of public lewdness to include the commission of a lewd act while trespassing in a dwelling and being observed by a lawful occupant.
